decisions.label: Edge first
decisions.note: How strongly the stars light from the edge in (loading.edge; 1 as built, 0 plain random). Remembered on this browser; takes effect on the next load (the screen is over before the game can pause).

decisions.label: Stars a second
decisions.note: At most this many stars light a second, so a jump in the load fills over a moment (loading.rate; 90 as built). Remembered on this browser; takes effect on the next load (the screen is over before the game can pause).

decisions.label: Flash

decisions.label: Unlit stars
decisions.note: How bright the stars not yet lit show (loading.ghost; 0 as built: an empty sky, Ed's call, 2026-10-26). Remembered on this browser; takes effect on the next load (the screen is over before the game can pause).
